title.en: Trump claimed Iran's nuclear sites were 'obliterated'. Now another is in his sights
title.zh: 特朗普声称伊朗核设施已“被摧毁”，如今又盯上另一处

summary.en: Former President Trump claimed Iran's nuclear sites were "obliterated," but a newly targeted site is reportedly buried 600m under granite, making it impervious to even the most powerful US bunker-buster bombs.
summary.zh: 前总统特朗普曾声称伊朗的核设施已被“摧毁”，但据报道，一个新锁定的核设施深埋在600米花岗岩下，即使是美国最强大的钻地弹也无法触及。

body.en:
A year after US President Donald Trump declared Iran's nuclear sites had been "obliterated", his latest target is drawing attention to a facility that survived both phases of the war untouched — and raising questions about why it's now in his sights.

On Monday, Trump threatened to destroy Pickaxe Mountain, a buried nuclear site near Natanz in north-central Iran where Western intelligence suspects Iran is building an undeclared enrichment facility.

"We're going to take out Pickaxe Mountain. Tell the Iranians to be ready," he said on Monday.

"We're watching (Pickaxe Mountain) closely. We see no activity there. They're not doing well with their nuclear situation. Every time we hear about it, we blow it up. So they don't like talking about it."

The threat comes as just last week, Trump said Iran "will never have a nuclear weapon" and that its stockpile of enriched uranium was now "so far under a mountain" that it was unreachable by anyone except the US.

That follows comments last June, where Trump declared "all" nuclear sites in Iran had been "obliterated", raising a key question: If Iran's nuclear sites were obliterated last year, why is a previously untouched one now a key target?

Pickaxe Mountain is a heavily fortified site near Iran's already-damaged Natanz facility, housing two deeply buried tunnel complexes suspected of containing uranium enrichment capabilities and stockpiles.

Experts have assessed its depth at about 600m below granite, meaning it's beyond the reach of even the most powerful 'bunker-buster' bombs in the US arsenal.

The site was not among the three sites — Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan — targeted by US airstrikes last June, which were believed to house Iranian nuclear facilities .

"Monumental damage was done to all nuclear sites in Iran, as shown by satellite images," Trump said on 25 June 2025. "Obliteration is an accurate term!"

Construction at Pickaxe Mountain began in 2020 and has sped up since June last year — with the Iranian government describing the site as a centrifuge assembly plant.

As of June 2025, the facility was not assessed as operational — something the Institute of Science and International Security says could have been a "key reason why the site was not attacked by airstrikes in the June war".

The institute said satellite analysis and monitoring have raised questions about the "the nuclear activities Iran has planned for the site, specifically whether it includes plans for an enrichment plant".

Pickaxe Mountain isn't the only thing to have survived the alleged "obliteration".

title.en: A rural home, a missed appearance, and a terror probe: What happened to Ann Widdecombe?
title.zh: 一处乡村住宅，一次缺席，以及一场反恐调查：安·维德科姆身上发生了什么？

summary.en: Ann Widdecombe, a prominent right-wing politician, was discovered deceased at her home in England last week. Her death followed a television appearance from the same location just one day prior, prompting a terror investigation.
summary.zh: 英国右翼政治家安·维德科姆上周被发现死于家中。此前一天，她曾在家中通过电视露面，目前警方已对此事展开反恐调查。

body.en:
Ann Widdecombe appeared on TV at 8am from her rural home in the south of England. Hours later, producers were unable to reach her. The next day, 8 July, her body was found with serious injuries and a man has been arrested over her alleged murder.

A long-serving right-wing MP, 78-year-old Widdecombe’s alleged killing has captivated the UK.

While police initially said there was "no information to suggest that this is a terrorism related incident", that changed on Tuesday (AEST) when a 28-year-old white British man was charged with terrorism-related offences.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Widdecombe was a household name in Britain, first as a controversial, socially conservative politician and later as a media personality.

Her political career started in 1987, when she was elected as Conservative Party MP for Maidstone (later Maidstone and Weald). After 23 years in parliament, she stepped down in 2010.

In mid-2019, she returned to politics, seeking and winning a seat in the European Parliament with the Brexit Party. Her tenure ended with Britain's withdrawal from the European Union in January 2020. In 2023, she joined Nigel Farage's Reform UK, the successor to the Brexit Party, as immigration and justice spokesperson.

Widdecombe was well known for her socially and politically conservative politics.

She opposed abortion, voluntary assisted dying, gay marriage and trans rights; She advocated for the reintroduction of the death penalty and supported gay conversion therapy.

Later she became a regular on British TV, appearing on Celebrity Fit Club, Strictly Come Dancing and Celebrity Big Brother.

Just after 8am on Wednesday 8 July (local time), Widdecombe appeared on the TalkTV streaming channel from her country home in the tiny village of Haytor in Devon, south-west England.

At 12.19pm, a producer from another TV channel reportedly spoke to Widdecombe on the phone, hoping to set up a video interview.

She was found dead in her home with serious injuries by paramedics the following day.

On 10 July, a 26-year-old man was arrested and charged with murder, before being released the following day.

The next night, a 28-year-old white British man was arrested 480km north of where her body was found. At the time, they said they did not believe her alleged attack was politically motivated, but that changed on Monday afternoon.

The investigation is now being handled by counter-terrorism police, after "new information and evidence came to light".

Widdecombe's death follows the high-profile murders of two other British politicians.

Labour MP Jo Cox was shot and stabbed by a Nazi-obsessed attacker during the Brexit campaign in...
body.zh: 上午 8 点，Ann Widdecombe 在她位于英格兰南部乡村的家中出现在电视上。几个小时后，制片人无法联系到她。第二天，即 7 月 8 日，她的尸体被发现，身上有重伤，一名男子因涉嫌谋杀她而被捕。 78 岁的维德科姆是一位长期任职的右翼议员，他涉嫌被杀的事件引起了英国的关注。 虽然警方最初表示“没有信息表明这是一起恐怖主义相关事件”，但周二（澳大利亚东部标准时间）情况发生了变化，一名 28 岁的英国白人男子被指控犯有恐怖主义相关罪行。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 维德科姆在英国是一个家喻户晓的名字，他首先是一位有争议的社会保守派政治家，后来成为一名媒体人物。 她的政治生涯始于 1987 年，当时她当选为梅德斯通（后来的梅德斯通和韦尔德）选区的保守党议员。在议会任职 23 年后，她于 2010 年辞职。 2019年中，她重返政坛，与脱欧党一起寻求并赢得欧洲议会席位。她的任期随着英国于2020年1月退出欧盟而结束。2023年，她加入脱欧党的继承者奈杰尔·法拉奇领导的英国改革党，担任移民和司法发言人。 维德科姆因其社会和政治保守主义政治而闻名。 她反对堕胎、自愿协助死亡、同性婚姻和变性人权利；她主张重新引入死刑并支持同性恋转变疗法。 后来她成为英国电视节目的常客，出现在《名人健身俱乐部》、《舞动奇迹》和《名人老大哥》中。 7 月 8 日星期三（当地时间）上午 8 点刚过，Widdecombe 在她位于英格兰西南部德文郡海托小村庄的乡间别墅中出现在 TalkTV 流媒体频道上。 据报道，中午 12 点 19 分，另一家电视频道的制片人通过电话与 Widdecombe 通话，希望安排一次视频采访。 第二天，医护人员发现她死在家中，伤势严重。 7 月 10 日，一名 26 岁男子被捕并被指控谋杀，第二天被释放。 第二天晚上，一名 28 岁的英国白人男子在尸体发现地以北 480 公里处被捕。当时，他们表示不相信她所谓的袭击是出于政治动机，但周一下午情况发生了变化。 在“新的信息和证据曝光”后，反恐警察正在进行调查。 维德科姆去世之前，另外两名英国政客也遭到了备受瞩目的谋杀。 工党议员乔·考克斯在英国脱欧运动期间被一名痴迷于纳粹的袭击者开枪刺伤。

reflection.en: The sudden passing of a public figure reminds us of life's inherent fragility and the universal truth that "it is appointed for man to die once." This event, shrouded in investigation, underscores how quickly circumstances can change, moving from public presence to private mystery. In such moments, we are called to reflect on the preciousness of each day...
reflection.zh: 一位公众人物的突然离世，提醒我们生命的脆弱和“人人都有一死”的普世真理。这起笼罩在调查中的事件，凸显了境况变化之快，从公众视野的出现转瞬变为私密的谜团。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召去反思每一天的宝贵，以及在雅伟面前我们终有一死的最终现实。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: How US commerce secretary's Epstein links were uncovered by British whistleblower
title.zh: 英国举报人如何揭露美国商务部长与爱泼斯坦的联系

summary.en: Simon Andriesz made the discovery about Howard Lutnick in publicly released Epstein files.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A British man has told the BBC how he unearthed evidence indicating that his former employer, Howard Lutnick - now US commerce secretary - failed to disclose a business relationship with the paedophile financier, Jeffrey Epstein.

Simon Andriesz, previously a managing director at a Wall Street firm, discovered an email chain from 2018 in which Lutnick and Epstein had discussed the prospects of a start-up business they were both involved in.

Andriesz shared his findings - from the millions of released Epstein files - with US politicians on the influential House Oversight Committee, ahead of an appearance there by Lutnick in May.

Lutnick told the committee that, to the best of his knowledge, he had only learned this year that Epstein had been an investor in the firm. Speaking on his behalf, the US Commerce Department told us there was no evidence of wrongdoing.

Andriesz also discovered in the files that one of Lutnick's firms had made plans in 2013 to go into business with another figure linked to Epstein, the then-Prince Andrew, by commercially exploiting the contacts the former UK trade envoy had made.

"What it involved was a loan to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor of £1m... to basically buy a prince," he tells File on 4 Investigates.

"I was completely shocked," says Andriesz, describing the moment when he discovered his own name in the Epstein files - a massive collection of documents, photos, video and emails relating to the notorious sex offender, released by the US government in the past year.

The specific files in which Andriesz appeared related to interviews he had given to the FBI while in dispute with his former employer, BGC Partners - a financial brokerage firm, part of Lutnick's Cantor Fitzgerald group.

In 2016, Andriesz had raised concerns internally about accounting irregularities at the firm. He was sacked in 2017, but some of his allegations later led to BGC being ordered to pay a $3m (£2.24m) penalty by the US derivatives regulator for "numerous supervision, reporting, and record-keeping violations".

BGC told us that Andriesz's allegations lacked credibility and were "categorically false". It said the claims had been investigated by authorities in several jurisdictions which, according to BGC, had not substantiated the allegations.

Andriesz spoke to the FBI about BGC, and about the firm's ultimate boss, Lutnick, in 2020-21 - after Epstein had killed himself in jail while awaiting trial on sex trafficking charges.

The Epstein files show Andriesz alleged that Lutnick had had undeclared business ties with Epstein. The FBI did not investigate these accusations.

body.zh: 一名英国男子告诉 BBC，他如何发现证据表明他的前雇主霍华德·卢特尼克（现任美国商务部长）未能披露与恋童癖金融家杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的业务关系。 曾任华尔街公司董事总经理的西蒙·安德里斯 (Simon Andriesz) 发现了 2018 年的一条电子邮件链，其中卢特尼克和爱泼斯坦讨论了他们共同参与的一家初创企业的前景。 安德里斯在有影响力的众议院监督委员会与美国政界人士分享了他从数百万份已公布的爱泼斯坦文件中得出的发现，随后卢特尼克于五月份出现在众议院监督委员会。 卢特尼克告诉委员会，据他所知，他今年才得知爱泼斯坦曾是该公司的投资者。美国商务部代表他告诉我们，没有证据表明存在不当行为。 安德里斯还在文件中发现，卢特尼克的一家公司曾于 2013 年制定计划，通过商业利用这位前英国贸易特使所建立的联系，与另一位与爱泼斯坦有联系的人物、当时的安德鲁王子开展业务。 “这涉及到向安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎提供 100 万英镑的贷款……基本上是为了购买一位王子，”他告诉 4 调查频道的 File。 “我完全震惊了，”安德里斯描述了他在爱泼斯坦档案中发现自己名字的那一刻。这些档案是美国政府去年公布的与这位臭名昭著的性犯罪者有关的大量文件、照片、视频和电子邮件。 安德里斯出现的具体文件与他在与前雇主 BGC Partners（一家金融经纪公司，隶属于 Lutnick 的 Cantor Fitzgerald 集团的一部分）发生争执时接受联邦调查局 (FBI) 的采访有关。 2016年，安德里斯在内部对公司的会计违规行为提出了担忧。他于 2017 年被解雇，但他的一些指控后来导致 BGC 因“大量监管、报告和记录违规行为”被美国衍生品监管机构勒令支付 300 万美元（224 万英镑）的罚款。 BGC 告诉我们，安德里斯的指控缺乏可信度，并且“绝对是错误的”。 BGC 表示，多个司法管辖区的当局已对这些指控进行了调查，但这些司法管辖区尚未证实这些指控。 安德烈斯 (Andriesz) 在 2020-21 年向联邦调查局 (FBI) 讲述了 BGC 以及该公司的最终老板卢特尼克 (Lutnick)，此前爱泼斯坦因性交易指控在监狱等待审判期间自杀。 爱泼斯坦的文件显示，安德里斯声称卢特尼克与爱泼斯坦有未公开的商业关系。联邦调查局没有调查这些指控。 安德里斯告诉 BBC，他很失望，因为似乎很少有人对他的发现感兴趣：“我正在揭露霍华德·卢特尼克的关系、财务联系……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Death toll from Bangkok bar fire rises to 30 as police probe safety lapses
title.zh: 曼谷酒吧火灾死亡人数升至30人，警方调查安全漏洞

summary.en: At least 30 people have died following a bar fire in Bangkok, with police investigating significant safety failures. Survivors reported that emergency exits were locked and lacked proper signage, contributing to the high casualty count.
summary.zh: 曼谷一家酒吧发生火灾，死亡人数已升至30人，警方正在调查安全漏洞。幸存者报告称，紧急出口被锁且缺乏明确标识，导致伤亡人数众多。

body.en:
Thai authorities are investigating if negligence was what led to the deadly inferno at a Bangkok bar late on Sunday, as survivors reported doors being locked and the lack of signage demarcating emergency exits.

The use of flammable materials as decoration may have facilitated the rapid spread of the fire, which originated near the stage, police say.

This "indicates a lack of caution and disregard for the safety of the patrons," Police General Kittiratt Phanphet said on Monday.

The blaze has left at least 30 people dead and dozens more injured. First responders found many of the victims in the restrooms at the end of the bar, from where experts believe they tried to flee – but couldn't.

As of Tuesday morning, 27 of the deceased victims have been identified, authorities said. More than 70 people are injured, 24 of them critically.

Preliminary investigations suggest the blaze was caused by a short circuit in an air conditioner, which quickly cut power throughout the bar.

But several people who had visited the bar earlier have described it as a dark room even in its original state. Phatsara Khamloet, who visited in May, told BBC Thai she had to navigate a "winding route" to reach the bathroom, and noted that the exits were not well marked.

Busakorn Saensuk, a fire safety expert from the Engineering Institute of Thailand who inspected the aftermath at Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao, said the door near the restrooms was locked, while the two doors at the entrance were partially obstructed by furniture and other objects.

Customers would instinctively have run away from the fire, towards the back where the restrooms were, Busakorn tells BBC Thai.

"If the emergency signs were lit, people would have been able to see how the door was locked and may have been able to unlock it," she says.

Busakorn also noted that the stage was decorated using highly flammable materials such as plastic flowers, while the ceiling was plastered with combustible foam.

Survivors have described the stage being engulfed in flames within seconds. Thai indie band Thotsakan, which was performing when the fire broke out, has lost two members to the tragedy.

Worsak Kanok Nukulchai, a professor specialising in structural engineering, believes many people would have died by inhaling toxic smoke "even before getting burned".

The first flames would have reacted with the flammable materials to produce carbon monoxide and hydrogen cyanide, often known as the "toxic twins" of fire smoke, he explains.

The bar was registered as a "restaurant with live music" rather than an "entertainment venue", Bangkok authorities have confirmed, and it was therefore not required to use fire-retardant materials.

Bangkok's Metropolitan Administration says it is reviewing regulations governing the materials...
body.zh: 泰国当局正在调查周日晚间曼谷一家酒吧发生致命火灾是否是疏忽造成的，幸存者报告说，酒吧门被锁住，也没有划分紧急出口的标志。 警方称，使用易燃材料作为装饰可能助长了舞台附近火势的迅速蔓延。 警察局长基蒂拉特·潘佩 (Kittiratt Phanphet) 周一表示，这“表明缺乏谨慎和对顾客安全的漠视”。 大火已造成至少30人死亡，数十人受伤。急救人员在酒吧尽头的洗手间里发现了许多受害者，专家认为他们试图逃离那里，但未能成功。 当局称，截至周二上午，27 名遇难者的身份已得到确认。 70多人受伤，其中24人伤势严重。 初步调查显示，火灾是由空调短路引起的，整个酒吧很快就断电了。 但一些早些时候去过这家酒吧的人形容，即使在原来的状态下，它也是一个黑暗的房间。 Phatsara Khamloet 今年五月来访，她告诉 BBC Thai，她必须走一条“蜿蜒的路线”才能到达卫生间，并指出出口没有明显的标记。 泰国工程学院消防安全专家 Busakorn Saensuk 视察了 Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao 的善后工作，他表示，洗手间附近的门被锁住了，入口处的两扇门被家具和其他物体部分遮挡。 布萨孔告诉 BBC Thai，顾客会本能地逃离火场，跑向后面的洗手间。 “如果紧急标志亮起，人们就能看到门是如何锁上的，并且可能能够打开它，”她说。 布萨孔还指出，舞台装饰使用了塑料花等高度易燃材料，而天花板则涂有可燃泡沫。 幸存者描述舞台在几秒钟内就被火焰吞没。火灾发生时正在表演的泰国独立乐队Thotsakan 已在这场悲剧中失去了两名成员。 结构工程专业教授沃萨克·卡诺克·努库尔柴 (Worsak Kanok Nukulchai) 认为，许多人“甚至在被烧伤之前”就会因吸入有毒烟雾而死亡。 他解释说，最初的火焰会与易燃材料发生反应，产生一氧化碳和氰化氢，它们通常被称为火灾烟雾的“有毒双胞胎”。 曼谷当局证实，该酒吧被注册为“有现场音乐的餐厅”，而不是“娱乐场所”，因此不需要使用阻燃材料。 曼谷市政府表示正在审查管理这些材料的法规......

Proverbs 27:12 warns that the prudent see danger and take refuge, while the simple keep going and suffer the consequences. This incident underscores the severe cost when basic safety...
reflection.zh: 曼谷酒吧火灾中因出口被锁和标识不清而造成的生命悲剧，提醒我们预见性和责任感至关重要。箴言27:12告诫我们，通达人见祸藏躲，愚蒙人前往受害。这起事件凸显了忽视基本安全预防措施所付出的沉重代价，强调了我们彼此保护的共同责任。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: US burrito giant Chipotle opening first outlet in Mexico
title.zh: 美国卷饼巨头Chipotle在墨西哥开设首家门店

summary.en: US fast-casual chain Chipotle is set to open its first restaurant in Mexico, a country where other American fast food brands have historically found it difficult to succeed with dishes that originated there.
summary.zh: 美国快餐连锁品牌Chipotle将在墨西哥开设其首家门店。此前，其他美国快餐品牌在菜肴发源地国家拓展业务时，曾面临难以成功的挑战。

body.en:
Chipotle Mexican Grill is set to open its first restaurant in Mexico this week, testing its appeal in the country that inspired its menu.

The chain, which has more than 4,100 outlets worldwide, said on Monday that the move is a "significant milestone" for the firm - known for its customisable burritos, tacos and bowls.

The announcement has been met with a mixed response on social media, with many users mocking the decision.

US restaurant chains have struggled to succeed in the countries their dishes originated. Taco Bell no longer has any outlets in Mexico, while Domino's Pizza has pulled out of Italy.

Chipotle boss Scott Boatwright said: "We are entering Mexico with deep respect for the country's culinary heritage and a commitment to delivering the Chipotle experience with excellence."

"We look forward to serving new guests and earning a place in Mexico's vibrant dining culture."

The new restaurant, located in the northeastern state of Nuevo León near the Texas border, serves as an "important proof-of-concept" the company said.

The company plans to open more restaurants in the state and expand into Mexico City in 2027 as part of its collaboration with Mexican restaurant operator Alsea, which also operates brands including Domino's Pizza, Starbucks and Chili's.

"Bold move selling Mexico a corporate version of Mexico," a commenter on X said.

Another X post questioned why Mexicans would pay for Chipotle when they have "perfectly fine and healthy food available to them?"

"It's like Pizza Hut [opening a] location in Napoli, makes no sense," said another.

"Next up, Panda Express opening its first mainland China location," one post read, referring to the US chain that specialises in Chinese food.

The move could be an important test for Chipotle's plans to expand globally, one wrote, while another suggested the chain could do well as a "tourist novelty".

The company plans to open up to 370 new restaurants globally this year, including new outlets in Singapore and South Korea.

Many commenters drew comparisons with other US chains like Taco Bell that have tried to break into countries that their menus took inspiration from.

Taco Bell has tried and failed to establish itself in Mexico twice, despite being one of the world's biggest fast food franchises.

The chain moved out of the country in 2010 after failing to attract Mexican diners.

Domino's Pizza closed its last outlets in Italy - the birthplace of pizza - in 2022 after facing stiff competition from local restaurants since it opened there seven years earlier.
body.zh: Chipotle Mexican Grill 将于本周在墨西哥开设第一家餐厅，以测试其在墨西哥的吸引力。 该连锁店在全球拥有 4,100 多家门店，周一表示，此举对于该公司来说是一个“重要的里程碑”——该公司以定制墨西哥卷饼、炸玉米饼和碗而闻名。 这一消息在社交媒体上引起了不同的反响，许多用户嘲笑了这一决定。 美国连锁餐厅一直在其菜肴的起源国努力取得成功。塔可钟 (Taco Bell) 在墨西哥不再有任何门店，而达美乐披萨 (Domino's Pizza) 则退出了意大利。 Chipotle 老板斯科特·博特赖特 (Scott Boatwright) 表示：“我们进入墨西哥是怀着对这个国家烹饪传统的深深尊重，并致力于提供卓越的 Chipotle 体验。” “我们期待为新客人提供服务，并在墨西哥充满活力的餐饮文化中赢得一席之地。” 该公司表示，这家新餐厅位于新莱昂州东北部，靠近德克萨斯州边境，是“重要的概念验证”。 作为与墨西哥餐厅运营商 Alsea 合作的一部分，该公司计划在该州开设更多餐厅，并于 2027 年扩展到墨西哥城。Alsea 还经营 Domino's Pizza、星巴克和 Chili's 等品牌。 “向墨西哥出售企业版墨西哥的大胆举动，”X 上的一位评论者说道。 另一篇 X 帖子质疑，当墨西哥人拥有“完美健康的食物”时，为什么他们还要花钱买 Chipotle？ 另一位人士表示：“这就像必胜客在那不勒斯开设分店一样，毫无意义。” 一篇帖子写道：“接下来，熊猫快餐将在中国大陆开设第一家分店。”指的是这家专门经营中餐的美国连锁店。 一位人士写道，此举可能是对Chipotle全球扩张计划的一次重要考验，而另一位人士则表示，该连锁店可以作为“旅游新奇”而做得很好。 该公司计划今年在全球开设多达 370 家新餐厅，其中包括在新加坡和韩国的新店。 许多评论者将其与塔可钟等其他美国连锁店进行了比较，这些连锁店试图打入其菜单灵感来源的国家。 尽管塔可钟是世界上最大的快餐连锁店之一，但它曾两次尝试在墨西哥站稳脚跟，但均以失败告终。 由于未能吸引墨西哥食客，该连锁店于 2010 年迁出该国。 达美乐披萨 (Domino's Pizza) 于 2022 年关闭了其在披萨发源地意大利的最后一家门店，自七年前在意大利开业以来，面临着当地餐厅的激烈竞争。

title.en: Australian police reveal unseen photos 25 years after British backpacker murder
title.zh: 澳大利亚警方公布英国背包客谋杀案25年前未公开照片

summary.en: Australian police have released previously unseen photographs related to the 1999 murder of British backpacker Peter Falconio, hoping the images will prompt new leads. The investigation aims to locate Falconio's body and bring closure to the long-standing case.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚警方公布了与1999年英国背包客彼得·法尔科尼奥谋杀案相关的此前未公开的照片，希望能借此获得新的线索。此次调查旨在找到法尔科尼奥的遗体，并为这起悬而未决的案件画上句号。

body.en:
Police in Australia have released previously unseen photographs from their investigation into the murder of British backpacker Peter Falconio 25 years ago.

Falconio, from Huddersfield, was shot on a remote stretch of highway near the Northern Territory town of Barrow Creek, about 186 miles (300km) north of Alice Springs on 14 July 2001.

His body has never been found and police hope the images could jog memories that could lead to a tip-off. His killer, Bradley Murdoch, died of throat cancer aged 67 in jail last year, without disclosing where Falconio's remains might be.

The images include a full length picture of Murdoch staring straight at a camera during the police investigation.

Falconio's girlfriend Joanne Lees escaped from Murdoch, hiding in scrubland for several hours before she was able to wave down two men driving a truck.

One of the photographs taken by police shows Lees looking traumatised in the hours after the attack. Others show injuries she sustained, including after her wrists were bound with cable ties.

Northern Territory Police Force Commissioner Martin Dole said that 25 years was a "significant milestone" and that he hoped the release of new images could jog memories or lead to a tip-off.

"This was a traumatic and horrific event for Ms Lees, and for Peter's family, who have now gone such a long time without the answers they deserve," Dole said.

"While a murderer has been held accountable for his crimes, this investigation can never be considered closed until Peter's remains are found and his family can lay him to rest."

Other photos released by NT Police include of the orange Volkswagen Kombi van the couple had been driving as they travelled around Australia. It was found abandoned just off the Stuart Highway close to where the attack took place. Pictures of the crime scene are also among the tranche of pictures.

During his trial in December 2005, the court heard Murdoch, who was then 43, pulled up beside their vehicle, claiming to have seen sparks coming from the camper van Falconio was driving.

He then shot Falconio in the head as he inspected the vehicle, before taking 28-year-old Lees into his car and binding her wrists with cable ties, although she managed to escape.

Murdoch was convicted of Falconio's killing by a unanimous jury verdict, and he was also found guilty of the assault and attempted kidnap of Lees.

He had always maintained his innocence, despite DNA evidence linking him to the crime, and unsuccessfully appealed to overturn his convictions twice.

A few days ago police released bodycam footage of an interview with Murdoch a week before his death , as they tried to get him to reveal the location of the body.

In a statement on Tuesday, Commissioner Dole said: "It is deeply regrettable that Murdoch died...
body.zh: 澳大利亚警方公布了 25 年前英国背包客彼得·法尔科尼奥 (Peter Falconio) 谋杀案调查过程中未公开的照片。 2001 年 7 月 14 日，来自哈德斯菲尔德的法尔科尼奥在爱丽丝泉以北约 186 英里（300 公里）处的北领地城镇巴罗溪附近的一条偏远高速公路上被枪杀。 他的尸体从未被发现，警方希望这些图像能够唤起人们的记忆，从而线索破案。杀害他的凶手布拉德利·默多克 (Bradley Murdoch) 去年因咽喉癌在监狱中去世，享年 67 岁，但他没有透露法尔科尼奥的遗体可能在哪里。 这些图像包括默多克在警方调查期间直视镜头的全身照片。 法尔科尼奥的女友乔安妮·李斯逃离了默多克，在灌木丛中躲藏了几个小时，然后才挥手拦住了两名驾驶卡车的男子。 警方拍摄的一张照片显示，袭击发生后数小时内，李斯看上去受到了创伤。其他照片显示她受了伤，包括手腕被扎带绑住后的伤痕。 北领地警察局长马丁·多尔表示，25 年是一个“重要的里程碑”，他希望新图像的发布能够唤起人们的记忆或引发线索。 多尔说：“对于利斯女士和彼得的家人来说，这是一次痛苦而可怕的事件，他们已经很长时间没有得到应有的答案了。” “虽然凶手已被追究其罪行的责任，但在彼得的遗体被发现并且他的家人可以安息他之前，这项调查永远不会被视为结束。” 北领地警方公布的其他照片包括这对夫妇在澳大利亚旅行时驾驶的橙色大众 Kombi 货车。它被发现被遗弃在斯图尔特高速公路附近，靠近袭击发生地。犯罪现场的照片也在其中。 在 2005 年 12 月的审判中，法庭获悉当时 43 岁的默多克将车停在他们的车旁，声称看到法尔科尼奥驾驶的露营车发出火花。 随后，他在检查车辆时开枪射击了法尔科尼奥的头部，然后将 28 岁的李斯带上车，并用扎带绑住了她的手腕，尽管她设法逃脱了。 陪审团一致裁定默多克犯有杀害法尔科尼奥的罪名，他还被判犯有袭击和企图绑架利斯的罪名。 尽管DNA证据表明他与犯罪有关，但他始终坚称自己无罪，并两次上诉推翻定罪，但均未成功。 几天前，警方公布了默多克死前一周采访他的随身摄像机录像，当时他们试图让他透露尸体的位置。 多尔专员在周二的一份声明中表示：“默多克的去世令人深感遗憾......

reflection.en: After 25 years, the ongoing search for Peter Falconio's remains reminds us that truth, though sometimes hidden, has an enduring quality. Yahweh's word assures us that while deceit may seem to prevail for a time, truthful lips ultimately stand the test of time. We pray for the revelation of truth and for comfort for those who have long awaited answers.
reflection.zh: 25年后，对彼得·法尔科尼奥遗骸的持续搜寻提醒我们，真相虽然有时被掩盖，却具有持久的力量。雅伟的话语向我们保证，虽然欺骗可能暂时得逞，但诚实的言语最终会经受住时间的考验。我们为真相的显明以及那些长期等待答案的人们得到安慰而祷告。

verse.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verse.textZh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

title.en: Protests break out in US after man killed by ICE agents
title.zh: 美国爆发抗议，此前一名男子被ICE特工杀害

summary.en: Protests have erupted in the United States following the death of a 26-year-old Colombian man, who rights groups identified as having been killed by agents from Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
summary.zh: 在一名26岁的哥伦比亚男子被移民和海关执法局（ICE）特工杀害后，美国爆发了抗议活动，该男子身份已由人权组织确认。

body.en:
A United States immigration officer fatally shot a man identified by rights groups as a 26-year-old Colombian on Tuesday, an incident likely to fuel criticism of US President Donald Trump's deportation drive.

The shooting happened in Biddeford, a town of 22,000 people in the northern state of Maine, and comes a week after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent shot dead a Mexican man in Texas.

Maine's attorney general's office said initial reports suggested an ICE officer was "conducting an enforcement operation related to a final order of removal when the subject attempted to flee in a vehicle in the direction of the officer and was fatally shot".

It said the agent would be placed on leave in line with protocol after police-involved shootings. The FBI earlier said it was also investigating.

Daniel Boucher, 71, told Agence France-Presse (AFP) he heard a "lot of pop, pop, pops" before seeing ICE agents pull a person from a white car with a bloodied head and face.

"At that point I clearly heard the victim say 'I tried to stop,' something to that effect," he said.

"Then he was on the ground. I could only see the legs and the stomach, and at one point, I could see that his stomach stopped going, and I knew that he had expired."

Boucher said that when he confronted one of the agents at the scene, the man had tried to run him over.

"The vehicle attempted to flee the scene and fearing for public safety an officer discharged his weapon. The driver of the vehicle was struck, and emergency services were immediately contacted. He passed away from his injuries," they said.

The Maine Immigrants' Rights Coalition and Presente Maine, which jointly identified the victim but did not name him, said the man was authorised to work in the US.

"We will not let this death be reduced to a footnote in this administration's enforcement statistics," said Crystal Cron, executive director of Presente Maine.

Governor Janet Mills, citing an unconfirmed US news report that the man shot was not the intended target of the ICE operation, said she was "horrified by this tragedy".

"This development makes this tragedy even more disturbing and infuriating, and it underscores the reckless and haphazard manner in which immigration enforcement operations are being conducted in Maine and across the country," she said in a post on X.

title.en: UN accuses Hamas of hampering aid as EU pledges billions to rebuild Gaza
title.zh: 联合国指责哈马斯阻碍援助，欧盟承诺数十亿重建加沙

summary.en: The United Nations has accused Hamas of impeding relief operations, making humanitarian aid increasingly dangerous amidst an ongoing crisis in Gaza. Meanwhile, the European Union has pledged billions of euros towards the future rebuilding of the region.
summary.zh: 联合国指责哈马斯阻碍救援行动，导致加沙地带持续的人道主义危机中，人道援助变得日益危险。与此同时，欧盟承诺将投入数十亿欧元用于该地区的未来重建。

body.en:
A senior United Nations official has accused Hamas of interfering with humanitarian deliveries in Gaza and intimidating aid workers, warning that the group's actions were making relief operations increasingly dangerous.

Palestinian Islamist movement Hamas continues to control parts of Gaza, even after Israeli forces expanded their presence across the majority of the territory.

In a statement on Monday, UN deputy special coordinator for the Middle East peace process, Ramiz Alakbarov, said he "strongly" condemned the obstruction of humanitarian operations by Gaza's de facto authorities, referring to Hamas.

Hamas' actions "endangered humanitarian personnel, intimidated workers delivering life-saving food assistance and disrupted life-saving humanitarian operations", he said.

Armed men linked to Hamas allegedly forced their way into a food distribution point in Jabalia in the northern Gaza Strip on Saturday, the UN statement said.

Militants "also entered a WFP (World Food Programme) warehouse and reportedly assaulted two truck drivers who were delivering humanitarian supplies", it added.

Alakbarov said "these incidents are not isolated" and "reflect an increasingly dangerous pattern of intimidation, violence and obstruction, including smuggling attempts, targeting and abusing humanitarian operations".

He warned that such actions were hampering the delivery of life-saving assistance at a time when civilians across Gaza faced severe hardships.

An official from the Hamas-run interior ministry in Gaza rejected the accusations, calling them unfounded.

"These are baseless accusations. The police and security forces continue to protect aid trucks and distribution centres and facilitate the work of international and humanitarian organisations," he told AFP.

COGAT, the Israeli defence ministry body in charge of civilian matters in the Palestinian territories, criticised Hamas over the latest accusation.

"This constitutes further clear evidence that Hamas cynically exploits the humanitarian space and the aid intended for the residents of the Gaza Strip for its own purposes," COGAT said in a statement.

Dubravka Suica, the EU commissioner for the Mediterranean, has announced an EU pledge of "almost 900 million euros or one billion [US] dollars" at the start of a donor meeting in Brussels.

"We now need the conditions on the ground that will allow the support to reach the people in Gaza," Suica said.

title.en: US strikes Iran for third night as Trump says deal still 'possible' while announcing Hormuz fees
title.zh: 美国对伊朗进行第三晚打击，特朗普称协议仍“可能”并宣布霍尔木兹费用

summary.en: US forces have conducted a third night of strikes against Iran, while President Trump indicated that a deal remains "possible." Meanwhile, Iran's foreign minister asserted his country's perpetual guardianship of the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国军队对伊朗进行了第三晚的打击，而特朗普总统表示达成协议仍“有可能”。与此同时，伊朗外交部长宣称他的国家将“永远”是霍尔木兹海峡的守护者。

body.en:
The United States launched a third night of strikes on Iran as US President Donald Trump planned to reimpose a blockade on Iranian ports and floated a 20 per cent fee on cargo in the vital Strait of Hormuz.

The US military said its five-hour mission hit targets across Iran, including coastal Bushehr and Bandar Abbas, to "degrade Iran's ability to attack commercial shipping".

After the strikes, Iran's Revolutionary Guards announced they had in turn fired missiles and drones on Bahrain, targeting a residential building for US forces and other facilities.

US Central Command said it began strikes at Trump's direction just after he told a US radio show that Iran would be hit "very hard tonight, and we're going to hit them hard tomorrow. And there's not a damn thing they can do about it."

He later told reporters at the White House that the US was attacking Iranian capabilities in the strait.

Soon after, the United Arab Emirates defence ministry said Iranian cruise missiles struck two Emirati oil tankers, the Mombasa and Al Bahiyah, while transiting the southern lane of the strait in Omani territorial waters, killing one crew member and injuring eight others.

The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said a tanker had been hit by an unknown projectile while travelling 40 nautical miles north-east of Oman's Qalhat and that all crew were safe.

Reuters could not immediately verify whether the UKMTO report referred to the same incident as the one reported by the UAE's defence ministry. Iran has not commented on the latest attacks.

"The Hormuz Strait is OPEN, and will remain OPEN, with or without Iran. We are reinstating THE IRANIAN BLOCKADE," Trump had said earlier on Monday on Truth Social.

"The USA will be, from this point forward, known as 'THE GUARDIAN OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT', but as such, and as a matter of FAIRNESS, will be reimbursed, at the rate of 20% on all cargo shipped."

Iran's top joint military command said the US had no role in determining the future of Hormuz and would not be allowed to intervene. Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said in a post on X that his country was the guardian of the strait and would remain so "forever", adding in response to Trump's comments that: "20% is of course too much. We will be fair."

title.en: Person killed in ICE-involved shooting in Maine
title.zh: 缅因州发生ICE参与的枪击事件致一人死亡

summary.en: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents were involved in a fatal shooting in Biddeford, Maine, according to the state's House speaker. This incident follows another alleged shooting by ICE agents in Texas during a traffic stop days earlier.
summary.zh: 据缅因州众议院议长称，美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）特工在比迪福德卷入了一起致命枪击事件。几天前，ICE特工在德克萨斯州的一次交通检查中也涉嫌枪击了一名男子。

body.en:
US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents were involved in a fatal shooting in Biddeford, according to Maine's House speaker. It comes days after ICE allegedly shot a man in Texas during a traffic stop.

One person was killed in a shooting involving United States immigration agents in Maine, the state's top lawmaker said.

"This morning a shooting occurred in Biddeford. A person was killed. ICE was involved," House Speaker Ryan Fecteau wrote on Facebook.

Biddeford police declined to comment and referred inquiries to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) , which did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The FBI said it responded immediately to assist at the scene of the shooting but did not offer any additional information.

Senator Angus King from Maine said Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told him the agent opened fire in Biddeford after the man tried to use his vehicle as a weapon against agents who were pursuing him for deportation.

An eyewitness to Monday's shooting, Lucas Scott, told local media he heard four gunshots after several ICE agents surrounded a white car.

The man shot was a 26-year-old from Colombia according to advocacy groups Maine Immigrants’ Rights Coalition and Presente! They said he was authorized to work in the US and had a Social Security number.

Project Relief, an immigrant rights group, said in a social media post that one of its community members was killed during an encounter with ICE in Biddeford and that it was in contact with the person's family.

"This was a young person whose life was cut short," the group said, calling for justice and support for the family and community.

Maine Governor Janet Mills said she had been briefed on the fatal shooting "involving Federal law enforcement" and that state authorities were working with federal authorities to determine what happened.

The reported shooting came days after ICE agents shot a man during a vehicle stop in Texas. Officials later said the man was not the intended target.

If an ICE officer delivered the fatal shot, it would mark at least the ninth death, including the killings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good in Minnesota, linked to an encounter with federal immigration officials since President Donald Trump launched an immigration crackdown.

It also comes amid a newly intensified anti-immigration push by the Trump administration.

Since the beginning of June, ICE arrests in Maine have more than quadrupled to around 70 per day in early July, according to internal ICE data shared with Reuters news agency by a source.

title.en: South Korea airs concerns over North Korean border activity
title.zh: 韩国对朝鲜边境活动表示担忧

summary.en: South Korea has raised concerns regarding North Korea's activities along the demilitarized zone, suggesting they might violate the 1953 armistice agreement.
summary.zh: 韩国对其邻国在两国非军事区沿线的行动表示担忧，认为这些行动可能违反了1953年的停战协定。

body.en:
South Korea has voiced concern that its neighbor's actions along the demilitarized zone between the two countries may be in breach of the 1953 armistice agreement.

Emboldened by its security and economic alliance with Moscow and flush with cash after sending troops and military equipment to support Russia's  invasion of Ukraine, North Korea is testing boundaries closer to home.  

In a meeting in late June with the United Nations Command, South Korea's Defense Ministry expressed concern about activity by North Korean engineers at a number of locations along the length of the 238-kilometer-long (148 miles) Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), which has divided the Korean Peninsula since an armistice brought the 1950-53 Korean War to an uneasy conclusion.

There have been countless clashes and incursions over the DMZ in the decades since, with North Korean invasion tunnels detected deep underground, defectors risking their lives to cross minefields and barbed wire entanglements to reach freedom in the South, as well as the occasional exchange of gunfire.

Choo Jae-woo, a professor of foreign policy at Kyung Hee University in Seoul, believes the North is now probing to see how far it can push before it meets resistance.

"They are testing the limits," he told DW. "They know they have the support of both Russia and China in all their endeavors — military, economic, geopolitical — and Pyongyang feels that now is the time to see how far it can go."

"We see this elsewhere, in the way the North is building advanced new warships, and it would not surprise me if we start to see similar testing of the NLL [the Northern Limit Line] in the West Sea," he said.

The NLL is the sea border off the west coast of the peninsula that North Korea disputes and has seen a number of deadly clashes, most recently in 2010 when North Korea fired around 170 artillery rounds at the island of Yeonpyeong, killing four South Koreans and injuring 19.

Experts say the North stepped up its probing of what the UN Command finds acceptable on the DMZ around April 2024, months after Kim Jong Un announced that he was redefining ties with South Korea.

Instead of a stated aim of reconciliation and reunification, Pyongyang now sees relations as being between "two hostile countries and two belligerents at war."

North Korean engineering troops have erected new fences, constructed anti-tank berms and ditches, dug trenches, built new military roads for greater access, cleared land and laid new minefields.

The work has been carried out on the North's side of the military demarcation line (MDL), but it has crept ever closer to that marker, which is the exact half-way point in the 4-kilometer-wide DMZ.

body.zh: 韩国对其邻国在两国间非军事区的行动可能违反 1953 年停战协定表示担忧。 由于与莫斯科的安全和经济联盟的鼓舞，以及在派遣军队和军事装备支持俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后资金充裕，朝鲜正在测试离本土更近的边界。 在 6 月底与联合国司令部举行的一次会议上，韩国国防部对朝鲜工程师在 238 公里（148 英里）长的非军事区 (DMZ) 沿线多个地点的活动表示担忧。自停战协议导致 1950-53 年朝鲜战争结束以来，该地区一直将朝鲜半岛一分为二。 此后的几十年里，非军事区发生了无数的冲突和入侵，朝鲜的入侵隧道在地下深处被发现，叛逃者冒着生命危险穿越雷区和铁丝网以到达韩国的自由，偶尔还会有交火。 首尔庆熙大学外交政策教授 Choo Jae-woo 认为，朝鲜现在正在探索在遇到阻力之前能走多远。 “他们正在测试极限，”他告诉德国之声。 “他们知道他们的所有努力——军事、经济、地缘政治——都得到了俄罗斯和中国的支持，平壤认为现在是看看自己能走多远的时候了。” 他说：“我们在其他地方看到了这一点，比如朝鲜正在建造先进的新型军舰，如果我们开始在西海看到类似的北方界限线测试，我不会感到惊讶。” NLL是朝鲜半岛西海岸附近的海上边界，朝鲜对此存在争议，并发生了多起致命冲突，最近一次是在2010年，当时朝鲜向延坪岛发射了约170发炮弹，造成4名韩国人死亡、19人受伤。 专家表示，在金正恩宣布重新定义与韩国的关系几个月后，朝鲜在 2024 年 4 月左右加强了对联合国司令部认为非军事区可接受的内容的调查。 平壤现在不再将和解与统一的既定目标视为“两个敌对国家和两个交战国”之间的关系。 朝鲜工程部队竖立了新的栅栏，建造了反坦克护堤和沟渠，挖掘了战壕，修建了新的军用道路以方便通行，清理了土地并铺设了新的雷区。 这项工作是在军事分界线 (MDL) 的北侧进行的，但它已经越来越接近该标记，即 4 公里宽的非军事区的确切中点。 韩国军方表示，在部分地区，相关工作已经开展……

title.en: Iran: Living in limbo between war and ceasefire
title.zh: 伊朗：生活在战争与停火之间的不确定中

summary.en: Many Iranians are experiencing exhaustion, anger, and deep uncertainty as a result of repeated ceasefire violations, conflicting political messages, and continuous emergency measures.
summary.zh: 由于反复的停火违规、相互矛盾的政治信号以及持续的紧急措施，许多伊朗人正经历着疲惫、愤怒和深深的不确定性。

body.en:
Repeated ceasefire violations, contradictory political signals and ongoing emergency measures have fueled exhaustion, anger and deep uncertainty among many Iranians.

Since the ceasefire between Iran, the United States and Israel was announced, Iranians have repeatedly been told that the war is over.   

But at the same time, attacks, threats and diplomatic talks have continued. Iranian authorities talk about negotiations, progress and even sanctions relief one day, only to warn of retaliation, further strikes and threats to Iran's critical infrastructure the next.

This constant oscillation between war and diplomacy has left many people in  Iran caught between hope and dread.

For many, that uncertainty has become more psychologically damaging than the war itself. The problem is no longer just the fear of violence, but also the inability to imagine a stable future.

One lawyer based in Tehran, who asked not to be named, told DW that the hardest part of the current moment is not knowing when the crisis will end. "The most important feature of this moment is that the end of the war is unknown," she said. "When you cannot plan how to endure hardship, it puts enormous pressure on you."

She said she no longer has the motivation to work or start anything new. Even speaking freely in society feels difficult. In the city where she grew up in, she said, she now feels a sense of estrangement from some of the people around her.

That sense of paralysis appears to go well beyond individual frustration, affecting basic decisions about work, family and the future.

Combined with economic instability and the constant fear that violence could return at any moment, the result has been a wider mood of fatigue and social stagnation.

"We are completely hopeless," a resident of Isfahan city told DW. "This instability between peace and war has turned our mental state into a game, and we have no clear outlook for our future, or for our psychological and financial security."

The same person said the entire experience had become deeply corrosive, with trust in either side of the war, or in the possibility of a durable agreement, having largely collapsed.

The current uncertainty may weigh especially heavily on younger Iranians, many of whom have no direct memory of the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war or of life under prolonged military threat. For them, this is the first experience of living under the shadow of an open-ended regional conflict.

A nurse in western Iran told DW that when a society enters this kind of situation, trust in the future weakens and people begin postponing long-term decisions. "People start living as if the only goal is just to get through today," she said on condition of anonymity.

body.zh: 一再违反停火协议、相互矛盾的政治信号和持续的紧急措施加剧了许多伊朗人的疲惫、愤怒和深深的不确定性。 自伊朗、美国和以色列宣布停火以来，伊朗人多次被告知战争已经结束。 但与此同时，袭击、威胁和外交谈判仍在继续。 伊朗当局有一天谈论谈判、进展，甚至解除制裁，但第二天却警告称，伊朗的关键基础设施可能会遭到报复、进一步袭击和威胁。 战争与外交之间的不断摇摆使许多伊朗人陷入希望与恐惧之间。 对许多人来说，这种不确定性对心理的伤害比战争本身更大。问题不再只是对暴力的恐惧，而是无法想象稳定的未来。 一位不愿透露姓名的德黑兰律师告诉德国之声，目前最困难的部分是不知道危机何时结束。 “此时此刻最重要的特点是战争的结局是未知的，”她说。 “当你无法计划如何忍受困难时，就会给你带来巨大的压力。” 她说她不再有工作或开始任何新事物的动力。即使在社会上自由发言也感觉很困难。她说，在她长大的城市里，她现在对周围的一些人感到疏远。 这种瘫痪感似乎远远超出了个人的挫败感，影响了有关工作、家庭和未来的基本决定。 再加上经济不稳定和对暴力随时可能卷土重来的持续恐惧，结果导致了更广泛的疲劳情绪和社会停滞。 伊斯法罕市的一名居民告诉德国之声：“我们完全绝望了。” “和平与战争之间的不稳定使我们的精神状态变成了一场游戏，我们对未来、心理和财务安全没有明确的前景。” 该人士表示，整个经历已经变得具有严重的腐蚀性，对战争双方的信任，或者对达成持久协议的可能性的信任，基本上已经崩溃。 当前的不确定性可能对年轻的伊朗人造成尤其严重的影响，他们中的许多人对 1980-88 年两伊战争或长期处于军事威胁下的生活没有直接记忆。对他们来说，这是生活在无休止的地区冲突阴影下的第一次经历。 伊朗西部的一名护士告诉德国之声，当社会陷入这种情况时，对未来的信任就会减弱，人们开始推迟长期决策。 “人们开始生活，好像唯一的目标就是度过今天，”她不愿透露姓名。 对于没有直接...的一代人

reflection.en: Living in prolonged uncertainty, like the situation in Iran, can be profoundly draining, leaving people feeling exhausted and without clear direction. Lamentations 3:22-23 reminds us that even in sustained crises, Yahweh’s loyal love and compassions are new every morning, offering a fresh source of strength and hope for each day.
reflection.zh: 像伊朗局势这样长期生活在不确定性中，会让人感到极度疲惫，失去明确的方向。耶利米哀歌3:22-23提醒我们，即使在持续的危机中，雅伟的慈爱永不断绝，他的怜悯永不止息，每天早晨都是新的，为我们每日提供新的力量和希望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Kenya: What impact will Dangote's new refinery have on the region?
title.zh: 肯尼亚：丹格特的新炼油厂将对该地区产生什么影响？

summary.en: Is Kenya Africa's next major energy hub? A plan from Dangote Industries to build a massive refinery off the country's coast could reshape fuel supply, trade and economic growth across East Africa.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Is Kenya Africa's next major energy hub? A plan from Dangote Industries to build a massive refinery off the country's coast could reshape fuel supply, trade and economic growth across East Africa.

Nigerian billionaire and business tycoon Aliko Dangote last week confirmed the final location of his new oil refinery in East Africa: Lamu Island off the Kenyan coast.

The facility is set to change not only Kenya but the entire region, with a projected refinery output of 700,000 barrels per day. Once operational, the facility is expected to become Africa's second-largest refinery.

Oge Onubogu, a director and senior fellow at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, DC, told DW that "people on the ground [think] it's wonderful that this investment is coming into Kenya; just the potential about the jobs that could be created, not only for local Kenyan economies but more broadly for the region."

"It's a massive project, but one that is needed in many ways on the continent and in the East Africa region," she said.

Dangote Industries Limited has not yet announced the projected cost of the ambitious undertaking. However, according to Bloomberg, building the proposed refinery could run up a bill of up to $17 billion (€15 billion), making it one of the largest privately funded industrial projects in the region to date.

Leo Kemboi, an economist at the Institute of Economic Affairs Kenya, highlights that little is known about the details of the agreement between the Kenyan government and Dangote.

"We've not had pronouncements by the government of Kenya on what specific guarantees would be given, but since we've seen the many meetings between [Kenyan President William] Ruto  and Dangote, we know that certainly there are negotiations that are still ongoing," he told DW.

Dangote Industries intends to fund the project through a mix of internally generated revenue, bond issuances and proceeds from the planned initial public offering (IPO) of Dangote Petroleum Refinery, according to Reuters. However, Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission stated that it has neither received nor approved an IPO application, raising questions about the extent to which the financing process of the facility can be considered a done deal.

According to media reports, Dangote has said that any East African refinery project would require anti-dumping protections to prevent cheaper imported fuels from undercutting local refining operations. That is a prospect that Kemboi worries could backfire. 

"If too many [tax] incentives are given to Dangote, it will not be acceptable to any Kenyan, which has happened with many other investments [before]," he said.

body.zh: 肯尼亚是非洲下一个主要能源中心吗？丹格特工业公司计划在该国沿海建造一座大型炼油厂，这可能会重塑整个东非的燃料供应、贸易和经济增长。 尼日利亚亿万富翁和商业大亨阿利科·丹格特上周确认了他在东非新炼油厂的最终选址：肯尼亚海岸附近的拉穆岛。 该设施不仅将改变肯尼亚，而且将改变整个地区，预计炼油厂产量将达到每天 70 万桶。一旦投入运营，该设施预计将成为非洲第二大炼油厂。 华盛顿特区战略与国际研究中心主任兼高级研究员奥格·奥努博古 (Oge Onubogu) 向德国之声表示，“当地人士认为，这项投资进入肯尼亚真是太好了；它不仅可以为肯尼亚当地经济，而且可以更广泛地为该地区创造就业机会。” “这是一个庞大的项目，但非洲大陆和东非地区在很多方面都需要这个项目，”她说。 丹格特工业有限公司尚未公布这项雄心勃勃的事业的预计成本。然而，据彭博社报道，建设拟议炼油厂的费用可能高达 170 亿美元（150 亿欧元），使其成为该地区迄今为止最大的私人资助工业项目之一。 肯尼亚经济事务研究所经济学家利奥·肯博伊强调，人们对肯尼亚政府与丹格特之间协议的细节知之甚少。 他告诉德国之声：“我们尚未收到肯尼亚政府关于将提供哪些具体保证的声明，但由于我们看到了[肯尼亚总统威廉]鲁托和丹格特之间的多次会面，我们知道肯定有一些谈判仍在进行中。” 据路透社报道，丹格特工业公司打算通过内部产生的收入、债券发行以及丹格特炼油厂计划的首次公开募股（IPO）收益来为该项目提供资金。然而，尼日利亚证券交易委员会表示，它既没有收到也没有批准IPO申请，这引发了人们对该设施融资过程在多大程度上可以被视为已完成交易的疑问。 据媒体报道，丹格特表示，任何东非炼油厂项目都需要反倾销保护，以防止更便宜的进口燃料削弱当地炼油业务。肯博伊担心这种前景可能会适得其反。 “如果对丹格特给予太多[税收]激励，任何肯尼亚人都无法接受，[之前]许多其他投资都发生过这种情况，”他说。 “这是肯尼亚的事情。我们反抗，或者我们反抗，当人们觉得......

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: Volkswagen planning to cut up to 100,000 jobs globally
title.zh: 大众汽车计划在全球裁员多达10万人

summary.en: Volkswagen, which owns brands like Porsche and Audi, is reportedly planning to cut up to 100,000 jobs worldwide. The move comes as the group faces a significant decline in profits and intense competition, particularly from China.
summary.zh: 据报道，大众汽车集团（旗下拥有保时捷和奥迪等品牌）正计划在全球范围内裁员多达10万人。此举是由于该集团面临利润大幅下滑以及来自中国等地的激烈竞争。

body.en:
The chief executive of the German car giant Volkswagen Group has confirmed it is looking to cut up to 100,000 jobs – twice as many as previously stated.

The group, which includes Porsche, Audi, Seat and Skoda as well as the VW brand, had previously said it would axe some 50,000 posts in Germany by 2030.

It suffered a steep decline in profits last year – the result of falling sales in key markets, as well as increasing competition from Chinese brands moving into Europe.

In a widely-reported memo to staff, chief executive Oliver Blume said the Group's costs were 20% higher compared to rival businesses, and it would need to reduce its outgoings even further.

"We are currently assessing across all brands, companies and regions how many adjustments are actually necessary and feasible," he said.

"We need to become more efficient, more robust and simpler. We must reduce our costs."

He added the company had been "unable to confirm" alternative uses for four factories in Germany which have previously been threatened with closure.

Two of the plants, in Zwickau and Emden, are used for electric car production. But along with other factories in Hanover and Neckarsulm, they are seen as expensive to run.

VW's profits have fallen sharply in recent years. In 2023, it made an operating profit of €22.6bn ($25.8bn, £19.3bn). This dropped to €19.1bn in 2024, and then to just €8.9bn last year.

The group has been badly hit by a fall in sales in China, once one of its most lucrative markets. In the first six months of the year they were down 26% compared to last year.

In the US, sales fell more than 7%, in part due to the impact of tariffs on car imports introduced by the Trump administration.

Meanwhile Chinese brands have been moving aggressively onto international markets, introducing new technologies while benefitting from lower production costs than European rivals.

This has added to the pressure on established brands to keep their own costs under control, and slashed profit margins.

In late 2024, after threats of mass strikes, VW reached an agreement with the German trade union IG Metall to cut 35,000 jobs at its namesake brand by 2030, in a "socially responsible manner", with another 15,000 jobs to go at its other brands.

Last week saw widespread protests at Volkswagen sites across the country, ahead of a meeting of VW's supervisory board, which includes labour representatives as well as company managers.

Some industry analysts suggested to Agence France Presse that Volkswagen had deliberately publicised the number of 100,000 as a negotiating tactic, and that the final figure of cuts is likely to be lower.
body.zh: 德国汽车巨头大众汽车集团首席执行官证实，该公司正计划裁员 10 万人，是此前宣布的两倍。 该集团包括保时捷、奥迪、西雅特、斯柯达以及大众品牌，此前曾表示将在 2030 年之前在德国裁减约 50,000 个职位。 去年，该公司的利润急剧下降，原因是主要市场的销售额下降，以及中国品牌进入欧洲的竞争加剧。 在一份被广泛报道的员工备忘录中，首席执行官奥利弗·布鲁姆 (Oliver Blume) 表示，与竞争对手企业相比，该集团的成本高出 20%，并且需要进一步减少支出。 “我们目前正在评估所有品牌、公司和地区有多少调整实际上是必要和可行的，”他说。 “我们需要变得更高效、更稳健、更简单。我们必须降低成本。” 他补充说，该公司“无法确认”德国四家工厂的替代用途，这些工厂此前曾受到关闭的威胁。 其中位于茨维考和埃姆登的两个工厂用于生产电动汽车。但与汉诺威和内卡苏尔姆的其他工厂一样，这些工厂的运营成本也很高。 近年来，大众汽车的利润大幅下滑。 2023 年，其营业利润为 226 亿欧元（258 亿美元，193 亿英镑）。到 2024 年，这一数字将降至 191 亿欧元，然后于去年降至 89 亿欧元。 中国曾是该集团利润最丰厚的市场之一，该集团因中国销售额下降而遭受严重打击。今年前六个月，与去年相比下降了 26%。 在美国，销量下降超过 7%，部分原因是特朗普政府对汽车进口征收关税的影响。 与此同时，中国品牌一直在积极进军国际市场，引入新技术，同时受益于比欧洲竞争对手更低的生产成本。 这增加了知名品牌控制自身成本的压力，并大幅削减了利润率。 2024 年底，在大规模罢工威胁之后，大众汽车与德国工会 IG Metall 达成协议，以“对社会负责的方式”，到 2030 年在其同名品牌裁员 35,000 人，并在其他品牌再裁员 15,000 人。 上周，在大众汽车监事会召开之前，全国各地的大众汽车工厂爆发了广泛的抗议活动，监事会成员包括劳工代表和公司经理。 有业内分析人士向法新社暗示，大众故意公布10万辆的数量是一种谈判策略，最终的削减数字很可能会更低。

reflection.en: News of potential job cuts can bring significant anxiety about the future and personal security. In such moments of uncertainty, Yahweh invites us to bring our worries to Him through prayer. Instead of being consumed by fear, we can find peace by entrusting our concerns to His care.
reflection.zh: 潜在裁员的消息会给人们带来对未来和个人保障的巨大焦虑。在这样的不确定时刻，雅伟邀请我们通过祷告将忧虑带到祂面前。我们不必被恐惧吞噬，而是可以通过将担忧交托给祂的看顾来找到平安。

verse.textEn: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
verse.textZh: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事藉着祷告、祈求和感谢，将你们所要的告诉神。

title.en: Weather tracker: Unusually warm rivers affect French nuclear power plants
title.zh: 天气追踪：异常温暖的河流影响法国核电站

summary.en: Unusually high temperatures and below-average rainfall across western and central Europe have led to warm rivers, putting pressure on waterways used to cool French nuclear power plants.
summary.zh: 西欧和中欧大部分地区异常高温和低于平均水平的降雨量导致河流温度升高，给用于冷却法国核电站的水道带来了压力。

body.en: High temperatures and below average rainfall put pressure on waterways used to cool reactors Above average temperatures combined with below average rainfall across much of western and central Europe during June and the first half of July have placed increasing pressure on rivers, ecosystems and energy infrastructure. Persistent high pressure brought prolonged sunshine, suppressed rainfall and enhanced evaporation, causing river levels to fall and water temperatures to increase. These unusually warm rivers are affecting electricity generation in France, as several nuclear power stations rely on river water for cooling. Under French environmental regulations, operators must limit the amount of heat discharged back into rivers, meaning electricity output may need to be reduced when water temperatures become too high. Continue reading...
body.zh: 高温和低于平均水平的降雨量给用于冷却反应堆的水道带来了压力。6月和7月上半月，西欧和中欧大部分地区的气温高于平均水平，降雨量低于平均水平，给河流、生态系统和能源基础设施带来了越来越大的压力。持续的高压带来日照时间延长、降雨减少、蒸发加剧，导致河流水位下降、水温升高。这些异常温暖的河流正在影响法国的发电，因为一些核电站依靠河水进行冷却。根据法国环境法规，运营商必须限制排回河流的热量，这意味着当水温过高时可能需要减少电力输出。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of unusually warm rivers affecting power plants reminds us that creation itself can feel the strain of environmental changes. Romans 8:22 speaks of creation groaning, a poignant image for the pressure waterways are experiencing. This calls us to consider our interconnectedness with the natural world and our role in its well-being.
reflection.zh: 河流异常温暖影响核电站的新闻提醒我们，受环境变化影响，受造界本身也会感到压力。罗马书8:22提到受造之物一同叹息，这生动地描绘了水道所承受的压力。这促使我们思考与自然世界的相互关联，以及我们在其福祉中所扮演的角色。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: China’s graduate glut: millions enter a job market with little use for them
title.zh: 中国毕业生过剩：数百万人进入就业市场却无用武之地

summary.en: China is experiencing a record number of university graduates entering a job market with low demand for their skills, particularly in entry-level tech roles affected by AI and automation. This coincides with the traditional graduation season, a time of transition for students.
summary.zh: 中国正面临创纪录数量的大学毕业生进入就业市场，但他们的技能需求有限，尤其是在受人工智能和自动化影响的入门级科技岗位。这恰逢传统的毕业季，是大学生们过渡的时期。

body.en: Record numbers find there is little demand for their skills, as entry-level tech roles are hit by AI and automation This time of year is graduation season in China: traditionally a bittersweet period of solemn goodbyes and family celebrations as university students transition from campus life into adulthood. Now it also increasingly represents trepidation about the future. Each year, millions more graduates are thrust into China’s already saturated jobs market. The situation for this year’s cohort, flooding into an increasingly crowded pool of applicants fighting for an insufficient number of positions, is arguably the bleakest yet. Continue reading...
body.zh: 创纪录的数字发现，由于入门级技术职位受到人工智能和自动化的打击，对他们的技能的需求很少。每年的这个时候是中国的毕业季：传统上，随着大学生从校园生活过渡到成年，这是一个苦乐参半的时期，举行庄严的告别和家庭庆祝活动。现在它也越来越代表着对未来的恐惧。每年，都有数以百万计的毕业生涌入中国已经饱和的就业市场。今年的申请者涌入越来越拥挤的人群，争夺职位数量不足，这可以说是迄今为止最惨淡的情况。继续阅读...

Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever work we undertake, we are called to do it heartily, as for Yahweh and not for human employers. This perspective can bring dignity and purpose to every effort, even when external circumstances...
reflection.zh: 对于数百万面临严峻就业市场的毕业生来说，技能需求有限的消息可能令人沮丧。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论我们做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这种视角能为我们所做的每一份努力带来尊严和意义，即便外部环境充满挑战。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: China’s massive AI rollout - podcast
title.zh: 中国大规模人工智能推广——播客

summary.en: Senior China correspondent Amy Hawkins reports on China's extensive adoption of AI technology, which is being integrated into various sectors from medical avatars and food delivery drones to state surveillance.
summary.zh: 资深中国记者艾米·霍金斯报道了中国大规模采用人工智能技术的情况，该技术正被广泛应用于医疗虚拟形象、食品配送无人机以及国家监控等各个领域。

body.en: Senior China correspondent Amy Hawkins on China’s embrace of AI, from medical avatars to food delivery drones and state surveillance While the spread of AI has been met perhaps with a lot of scepticism in the west, China has fully embraced the technology, explains Amy Hawkins , from millions of users talking to AI doctors, to the use of intelligent robots in factories, and drones delivering food on the Great Wall of China. AI has also been eagerly taken up by the state, not least in the opportunities it provides for further surveillance, the Guardian’s senior China correspondent says. Continue reading...
body.zh: 资深驻华记者艾米·霍金斯 (Amy Hawkins) 谈论中国对人工智能的接受，从医疗化身到食品配送无人机和国家监控。艾米·霍金斯解释说，尽管人工智能的传播在西方可能遭到了很多怀疑，但中国已经完全接受了这项技术，从数百万用户与人工智能医生交谈，到在工厂中使用智能机器人，再到在中国长城上使用无人机运送食物。英国《卫报》驻华高级记者表示，国家也热切地采用人工智能，尤其是它为进一步监控提供了机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As China rapidly deploys AI across many aspects of life, including surveillance and medical avatars, it prompts us to consider the profound implications for human dignity. Yahweh created humanity in His own image, bestowing inherent worth that technology must always respect and serve, not diminish.
reflection.zh: 随着中国在生活各个领域迅速部署人工智能，包括监控和医疗虚拟形象，这促使我们思考其对人类尊严的深远影响。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了人类，赋予了我们固有的价值，科技必须始终尊重并服务于这一价值，而非削弱它。

verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

body.en: Before they left, the receptionist delicately straightened my father’s collar. I knew then they would be just fine Read more in the kindness of strangers series The food poisoning hit like a tsunami. I remember being out at a dumpling restaurant, grabbing a heap of napkins and just vomiting directly into them. I’ve never been sick like that in my life. I was travelling in Xi’an, China, with my father, who was then aged 88 or 89. I really should have been in hospital but I didn’t feel I could leave my dear dad on his own. Instead I retreated to my hotel room, where I spent the night projectile vomiting. A horrible, embarrassing experience. Continue reading...

reflection.en: This heartwarming story reminds us that acts of kindness towards those in vulnerable situations—the sick and the stranger—are deeply meaningful. Yahweh teaches that when we care for "the least of these," we are, in essence, caring for Him. The hotel staff's compassion for both the ill traveler and their elderly father beautifully illustrates this principle.
reflection.zh: 这个暖心的故事提醒我们，对那些身处困境的人——生病者和陌生人——施以善意，是意义深远的。雅伟教导我们，当我们照顾“这些最小的弟兄”时，我们实际上就是在照顾他。酒店员工对生病旅客及其年迈父亲的关怀，完美地诠释了这一原则。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Nearly two million evacuated as Typhoon Bavi barrels towards China
title.zh: 强台风巴威逼近中国，近两百万人被疏散

summary.en: A powerful typhoon, Bavi, is approaching China, prompting the evacuation of nearly two million people. In the Philippines, heavy rains associated with the storm have already caused two landslides, resulting in 17 fatalities.
summary.zh: 强台风巴威正逼近中国，导致近两百万人被疏散。在菲律宾，受台风带来的强降雨影响，已发生两起山体滑坡，造成17人死亡。

body.en:
China evacuated more than 1.8 million people on Saturday as Typhoon Bavi churned toward the major eastern city of Wenzhou after pummelling Japan's southern Sakishima island chain with heavy rain and violent winds and brushing past northern Taiwan.

Even as Bavi continues to slow and weaken on its northwesterly path over cooler seas, the typhoon is still a potent risk due to the sheer volume of moisture it holds within its rain bands, about the size of France from end to end.

Bavi had maximum sustained winds of 144 km/h, equivalent to Category 1 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale, and was about 200km southeast of Wenling in the eastern province of Zhejiang as of Saturday night (AEST), according to the National Meteorological Center.

Bavi is forecast to make landfall around Wenzhou, home to some 10 million people, early on Sunday.

State media said more than 1.7 million people had been evacuated across Zhejiang province, where Wenzhou is located, and more than 100,000 in neighbouring Fujian province.

"I'm a little worried, but I think it'll be OK. We've been through typhoons before. We'll get through it," said Wenzhou resident Huang Xinghuan, 50, who was out buying groceries at a traditional wet market before it closed ahead of the typhoon.

Huang said his family had stocked about two to three days' worth of water. "I think supplies are well guaranteed now. There's no need to panic or stockpile a lot of food or other supplies," he added.

While Japan and Taiwan have not so far reported any deaths from the typhoon, 17 people died in the Philippines due to heavy rains brought by an enhanced southwest monsoon, worsened by Bavi's impact.

Taiwan's fire department said 87 people had been injured, mostly falls from motorcycles or bicycles, as well as people falling over or being struck by objects.

More than 18,000 households and facilities across Okinawa, Japan lost power as the typhoon pounded Japan's remote southwestern islands, with the Miyako region hardest hit.

Japanese airlines cancelled dozens of flights, affecting more than 26,000 passengers.

"Miyako is taking worst of typhoon Bavi," professional storm-chaser James Reynolds posted on X from Ishigaki on Saturday.

"Conditions on Ishigaki gale force with some overnight gusts to typhoon strength."

In Taiwan, the government evacuated more than 14,000 people from mainly mountainous areas as the island shut down for the approach of Bavi to the north.

While Bavi did not make landfall on Taiwan, the government took precautions to prevent loss of life, given forecasts for almost 1 metre (3 feet) of rain in some areas.

summary.en: Typhoon Maysak, the first of the 2026 season to hit China, has caused severe flooding and damage in southern and central regions, leaving eleven people dead and others stranded on rooftops. The disaster also brought dangers like snakes and building collapses, with heavy rain also affecting Mumbai.
summary.zh: 2026年首个登陆中国的台风“麦萨克”给中国南方和中部地区带来了严重的洪涝灾害和破坏，造成11人死亡，许多人被困在屋顶上。此次灾害还带来了蛇患和房屋倒塌的危险，同时印度孟买也遭受了暴雨袭击。

body.en: Eleven reported dead as flooding also brings danger of snakes, while buildings collapse in Mumbai amid heavy rain As the first typhoon to make landfall in China for the 2026 season, Maysak has caused devastating damage in southern and central regions. The Guangxi region received intense downpours of up to 280mm in 12 hours, causing rivers to swell and dam walls to break. By Monday morning, flooding across the city of Nanning and surrounding areas had resulted in many people being stranded on rooftops. Flood waters pose additional threats in China because of the presence of wild and farmed snakes. On Thursday local media reported that hundreds of snakes , including cobras, had escaped from flooded breeding farms. Typhoon Maysak also aided the development of two destructive tornados that swept across central China later on Monday evening. This occurred when warm air from the south, brought up by Typhoon Maysak, collided with cold air in the north. Continue reading...

Three weeks before Bradley John Murdoch died, NT Police made a last-ditch effort to coax the convicted murderer to reveal the location of Peter Falconio's body.

Newly released body-worn video reveals the exchange — and a final insight into Murdoch's frame of mind.

In a small, stark office in Alice Springs Correctional Centre — known for its overcrowding and lack of air-conditioning — a plain-clothes female police officer gently implores Murdoch, dressed in prison greens, to disclose the whereabouts of the British tourist, who went missing in 2001.

"I need you to have a think about ... if Peter Falconio was your son, Quentin ... and somebody knew something about where his body was," the officer says.

"Don't beat around the bush because I'm just going to cut you short every time. I know nothing. Know nothing. I've said this for 22 years. I know nothing. You keep asking these questions. I know nothing."

Murdoch had been diagnosed with stage four throat cancer and had only a few weeks left to live. It was all but the final chance for Falconio's family to get the closure they had been waiting two decades for.

With assistance from United Kingdom police, the Australian officers planned to show Murdoch a video of Falconio's parents, Luciano and Joan Falconio, pleading for answers. He refused to watch it.

At one point in the exchange, the officer says, "I just want you to think about it", referring to the opportunity to offer closure.

"I'm not thinking about it, I've thought about it for 22 f---ing years," Murdoch replies.

"Now you're here at the last minute because I'm f---ing dying. No-one gives a f--- about me. Well, some people do."

Days later, Murdoch would enter palliative care. Police visited him one last time, hoping he'd make a dying confession, but that interaction only lasted 30 seconds.

On 16 July 2025, Murdoch died without revealing anything about Falconio's whereabouts.

Despite this, Falconio's parents, Luciano and Joan, said at the time that they still hold out hope because Murdoch may have told someone, and together with a $500,000 reward on offer, there's a chance they may still get answers.

SBS News tried to contact Falconio's family ahead of the 25th anniversary but was unable to reach them.

In March 2026, the pair told the UK's Daily Telegraph that the whole ordeal had "taken so much out of us".

"I think deep down I didn't think he would reveal where he put Peter," Joan said.

summary.en: Young men and boys are being lured into sharing intimate images — then blackmailed by organised criminal networks.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Young men and boys are increasingly being coerced into sharing intimate videos and images on social media platforms, before being blackmailed out of thousands of dollars, according to the eSafety Commission's third transparency report.

"Sexual extortion has reached catastrophic proportions, I'd say, being brutally targeted by organised criminal networks every day," eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant told ABC radio on Tuesday.

The transparency report, published on Tuesday by the eSafety Commission, said 85 per cent of the 2,206 complaints of sexual extortion they received between July and December in 2025 involved male victims, most of whom were aged between 18-39.

"But we're also seeing much younger kids coming to us, you know, 15, 16, 17-year-olds," Inman Grant said.

"We had 8,000 image-based abuse reports last year; that's the non-consensual sharing of intimate images and videos, and traditionally the first eight years [of reporting], it tended to be women and girls that were targeted," Inman Grant said.

"Fifty per cent of these reports are now financial sexual extortion targeting young men."

In one story shared by the eSafety Commission, 16-year-old Sam was targeted on Instagram after he liked a photo posted by a woman online who regularly posted flirty content.

'Jessica' direct-messaged Sam almost immediately, asking if he wanted to "have a bit of fun".

'Jessica's' tone immediately changed, replying: "Hey bro. Pay me. Fast payment."

The teenager was pressured to steal an Apple gift card from his family, or else the blackmailer would share the photo with his friends and family.

Sam's story is indicative of the rising trend of sexual extortion, and child sexual extortion and abuse, using Meta's Instagram, which the eSafety Commission said was the subject of 695 reports.

Extortion often started on one platform, like Instagram or dating app Tinder, before moving to chat-based platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram.

Inman Grant said criminals were using sophisticated methods to target young men, including "using generative AI to create very attractive personas", face-swapping technologies, and voice cloning.

"It is a horrendous crime that, in the worst-case scenario, leads to extreme mental distress and sometimes suicide."

Based on complaints received by the commission, TikTok was the most common platform for child sexual exploitation.

title.en: As Australia closes in on eliminating one cancer, another is showing up earlier in life

summary.en: New national data in Australia indicates a changing pattern in cancer diagnoses, with one type nearing elimination while another is being detected at younger ages, affecting a generation in new ways.

body.en:
Cervical cancer is vanishing from a generation of Australian women, with a new national data report revealing it's happening one age bracket at a time.

Among women aged 25 to 29, cervical cancer has almost disappeared. Incidence in that group has fallen from 9.3 cases per 100,000 in 2013 to a projected 0.5 in 2025 — a decline of roughly 95 per cent. The figures were released by the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW), the federal government's health statistics agency, on Tuesday.

Bowel cancer, a disease in retreat across every older age group in the country, has roughly tripled among Australians in their 30s over the past twenty-five years, the report shows — and alone among cancers in that age group, the extra diagnoses are showing up as extra deaths.

What has not changed significantly, however, is that nearly 9 in 10 cancers diagnosed in 2025 are estimated to occur in people aged 50 or older.

Australia started vaccinating girls aged 12 to 13 against human papillomavirus, the main risk factor for cervical cancer, in 2007, and ran a catch-up program for those aged 14 to 26 until 2009.

The vaccine, Gardasil, was developed from technology pioneered at the University of Queensland, approved by the Therapeutic Goods Administration in 2006, and funded by the Howard government at a cost of $632.9 million over four years.

The school-based program launched in April 2007, making Australia the first country in the world to add HPV vaccination to a national immunisation schedule. It was extended to boys aged 12 to 13 in 2013.

Cervical cancer typically takes 15 to 20 years to develop after HPV infection, so a lag between vaccination and falling incidence was expected — and data shows it has arrived precisely where the arithmetic predicted. Incidence among 25-to-29-year-olds began falling in 2014; among 30-to-34-year-olds, around 2020.

Once the second most commonly diagnosed cancer among Australian women aged 15 to 29, cervical cancer had fallen to ninth by 2021, and on current trends will drop out of the leading 20 cancers for that age group entirely by 2025.

Complete national incidence data currently runs only to 2021, so the AIHW projects the remaining years forward from the previous decade's trends — a method that applies to almost every 2025 figure in the report.

Vaccination arrived on top of a screening program that had already been driving the disease down for a generation. body.en:
A childcare worker stands accused of being one of Australia's worst child abuse offenders, with his alleged offences at dozens of childcare centres spanning more than 15 years.

The 35-year-old man is alleged to have created and transmitted child abuse material, impacting 158 victims, with 136 identified.

The victims were all pre-school or primary school-aged, with the alleged offences having occurred from 2009 to 2025 across 62 childcare centres the man worked at or attended.

The man was arrested and charged in July 2025 under Operation Moonbi after police seized almost 2.5 million files from electronic devices at his home and has been in custody.

He was initially charged with eight counts of online child abuse material offences on 10 July 2025, and was later charged with additional offences in April, June and July 2026 that have now reached 329 offences in total.

Australian Federal Police (AFP) acting commander Luke Needham said contact had been made with more than 121 families affected in Australia and overseas.

"The abuse of trust we alleged has occurred is devastating and will have lifelong ramifications for victims and their families," he told reporters on Monday.

Needham said some of the material was shared overseas, with the majority of the man's alleged industrial-scale offences taking place across dozens of centres in Sydney.

It includes 162 counts of producing child abuse material and 81 counts of filming a person engaged in a private act without consent.

Federal Education Minister Jason Clare said he would not comment on the accused but vowed the federal government's crackdown on the sector to weed out offenders would continue.

"I have been pretty blunt that not enough has been done in the past to keep our kids safe," he said.

He pointed to the establishment of a new National Early Childhood Worker Register, mandatory child safety training for educators and a national CCTV trial in centres as some of the new safeguards implemented.

"This is not the end. It's just the start. The terrible truth is this work will never end."

The case comes after the childcare sector underwent a national reckoning over widespread allegations of abuse and neglect.

body.en:
This article contains references to domestic violence, sexual and emotional abuse.

South Australia has unveiled a nation-first plan to ban domestic violence perpetrators and sex offenders from dating apps.

The state's acting premier Kyam Maher said the proposal would improve safety for those involved in dating online.

It follows a report released by the Australian Institute of Criminology in 2022 that found a third of respondents were subjected to sexual violence by someone they had met on an app or website in the previous five years.

Leesa Scanlon, an advocate behind the state government's push, said she experienced coercive control and domestic abuse in a past relationship.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"That person was very good at what they did and presented themselves in a way that would have made anyone feel very lucky," she said at a press conference on Monday.

"Over time, that person sought intentionally to strip parts of me away through the cycle of abuse that we see. This person also used platforms like dating apps to move from victim survivor to victim survivor.

"Today, meeting someone through a dating app is completely normal ... people deserve to use these platforms feeling confident that reasonable steps are being taken to keep them safe," Scanlon added.

Maher said the ban would protect victims by placing the onus on those who seek to do wrong.

He referenced legislation that prevents convicted child sex offenders from working with children, saying it would serve as a model for the ban.

"A couple of years ago we changed the legislation so that convicted child sex offenders can't work with children. And in that legislation the onus is on the offender," he said.

"So if you're a registered child sex offender and you work with children then you are committing an offence as the offender.

"And that's the model that, as a starting point, we're looking at here. If you have a conviction for sexual violence, for domestic violence, for child sex offences, then you will be banned from dating apps."

Under the proposal, these offenders would be barred from online dating platforms for at least 10 years and face jail time for breaches.

Serious offenders could be barred from online dating platforms for life, while those caught violating bans would face up to five years behind bars.

Examples included sexual assault or coercion and in-person image-based sexual abuse.

title.en: 'You've got no choice': The $1,475 fee leaving some in Australia feeling 'captive'
title.zh: “你别无选择”：1475澳元的费用让一些澳大利亚人感到“受困”

summary.en: A significant increase in visa fees in Australia is causing distress, as it transforms the ability to travel and return home into an expensive, unavoidable requirement for some individuals.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚签证费大幅上涨，导致一些人感到困扰，因为这使得旅行和回家的权利变成了一项昂贵且无法避免的义务。

body.en:
Richard Whitten's wife, Yoona, has lived in Australia for nine years — but she still pays a premium to travel outside the country.

On 1 July, the Australian government increased fees across a slew of visa categories overnight, with little warning.

The visa Yoona needs just to travel — the Resident Return Visa — saw one of the steepest increases of all: hiked from $490 to $1,475, a 201 per cent rise.

"Every five years, we'll have to pay that if she wants to travel. It's a pretty heavy cost," Richard told SBS News.

"Everything's gotten more expensive. Our mortgage has gone up, bills, groceries, daycare fees, everything. Then suddenly it's an extra $1,500 that we have to pay."
